original_request: Create a full professional dark Leeway website with a header, footer, 3 different 3D objects, and a video section explaining the Leeway standards with an avatar.
steps: Translate the user request into a professional website brief.
Define audience, purpose, page map, brand feel, and required sections.
Create two visual mockup directions before building.
Ask Leonard to approve one mockup direction or request edits.
After approval, create the live website room.
Add 3D object concept blocks and video/avatar explainer section.
Review the website against Leeway standards.
Return website link, supporting PDF if needed, receipt, and revision options.

tools.role: Create the plan, creative package, version history, and structured content.
Select available skills, worker lanes, and capability requirements.
Coordinate planning, approval, routing, and receipts.
Expose plan rooms, previews, website rooms, infographic rooms, and delivery links.
Govern durable storage, manifests, receipts, and memory control.
Generate website mockup images before build approval.
Render live website preview and final package.

mockups.name: Executive Dark Command Center
mockups.description: Dark professional Leeway website with hero section, glowing 3D core, standards cards, video/avatar panel, and strong header/footer.
mockups.approval_question: Approve Mockup A for a premium technology/business feel?

mockups.name: Magazine-Style Brand Story
mockups.description: Editorial layout with large headline, cinematic image blocks, 3D object cards, video explainer strip, and polished footer.
mockups.approval_question: Approve Mockup B for a storytelling and proposal-style feel?

failovers.rule: Use the best matching runtime lane and return the intended artifact.
If a render lane fails, return the plan room, text package, and receipt instead of pretending the final artifact exists.
If execution is blocked, create a work order for the missing lane and ask Leonard for approval or more data.

standards: Do not pretend the work is complete.
Use the correct tool or worker lane.
Ask for approval before heavy execution.
Return links, files, receipts, and next actions.
Keep Agent Lee's public voice poetic, grounded, brief, and disciplined.
